headline: Henderson Behavioral Health gains community visibility through veteran services partnership

signals.summary: Henderson Behavioral Health's veteran services program is being highlighted in a high-profile community partnership with Galleria Fort Lauderdale for a pop-up living garden fundraiser (Sept-Nov 2026). This represents positive public visibility and community engagement around their behavioral health mission.
signals.suggestedAction: Reach out to Henderson's marketing or community outreach lead to congratulate them on the veteran services visibility and explore whether they're planning HIPAA-compliant email campaigns to promote similar programs or donor initiatives. Position Paubox Marketing as a trusted partner for secure patient/veteran communications.
